f4.value: About the information on this website.

f2.value: The information on this website is general in nature and is not a substitute for a consultation with a registered health practitioner. It does not take your individual circumstances into account.

f3.value: Any surgical or invasive procedure carries risks. Individual results vary. Before proceeding, you should seek a second opinion from an appropriately qualified health practitioner.

f5.value: We take care to keep this website accurate and up to date, but information can change. Fees, rebates and availability are confirmed at your consultation.

f7.value: This website links to other websites, such as hospitals and Google Maps. We are not responsible for their content.

f9.value: If you have a medical emergency, call 000 or go to your nearest emergency department. For urgent facial trauma or infection, call us on {{phone}}.

f10.value: Have a question about your treatment?

f11.value: The best answers come from a consultation with one of our surgeons.
